block_list_reasons./terminal: PTY shell as the pod user (upstream WS opens with the pod token, verified); never for authors
block_list_reasons./api/packages: pip/uv install/remove/sync in the shared pod env; editor only probes /api/packages/sandbox (403, editing unaffected)
block_list_reasons./api/secrets: reads/writes secret keys and .env files on the pod filesystem
block_list_reasons./api/files: arbitrary file browse/read/create/move/delete/download in the workspace dir
block_list_reasons./api/ai: AI chat/completion and MCP refresh use pod-side provider keys; no egret policy over them
block_list_reasons./api/storage: lists/downloads objects from storage backends configured on the pod
block_list_reasons./api/home: workspace file listing, recent files, tutorial open (creates a file), other sessions' shutdown
block_list_reasons./api/kernel/copy: creates a second notebook file on the pod (Save-as copy) outside the draft store
block_list_reasons./api/kernel/rename: renames the notebook file, detaching it from the draft binding
block_list_reasons./api/kernel/install_missing_packages: installs packages from a cell's imports (same as /api/packages)
block_list_reasons./api/export/auto_export: writes html/md/ipynb into __marimo__/ beside the notebook
block_list_reasons./api/lsp: restarts/starts language-server subprocesses; editor probes /api/lsp/health (403, editing unaffected)
block_list_reasons./api/kernel/save_user_config: writes the shared marimo.toml under XDG_CONFIG_HOME for every editor on the pod; UX cost: the settings panel cannot persist changes (403)
block_list_reasons./api/datasources: pod-side DB connections/schema previews; data access must go only through egret's gateway. Editor calls discover on open (403, editing unaffected; the datasource panel is empty)
block_list_reasons./api/cache: reads/clears the pod's shared cache dir
block_list_reasons./api/environment: leaks OS, binary and full dependency versions (verified)
block_list_reasons./api/usage: leaks host memory/CPU totals (verified); the footer bars stop updating
block_list_reasons./api/sessions: lists every session on the pod, including other viewers'
block_list_reasons./api/status: server status and /api/status/connections (connection counts of all users)
block_list_reasons./auth: marimo's own login/token pages; the proxy injects the pod token, so browsers never need them
block_list_reasons./og: serves notebook thumbnails from __marimo__/ on the pod

not_blockable_by_prefix./api/kernel/save: needed for editing; accepts a `filename` (save-as) but marimo validates it is inside the workspace dir (files.py:152-180), so a rogue save can create/overwrite files inside the workspace only
not_blockable_by_prefix./api/kernel/save_app_config: needed to edit app config; rewrites the notebook header only
not_blockable_by_prefix./api/kernel/save_user_config: writes marimo.toml under XDG_CONFIG_HOME, shared by every editor on the pod; left open (not needed to be blocked for editing, but a design point: mount config read-only)

classification_of_remaining_routes./ (index), /assets/*, /{path:path}, /pub: allow: the editor/run app bundle itself
classification_of_remaining_routes./@file/{...}: allow: serves virtual files from the kernel's registry (mo.image/pdf/download outputs); marimo gates it on read scope; dot segments now rejected by the proxy. Residual: file names are session-global, unguessable-name only
classification_of_remaining_routes./public/{filepath}: allow: serves files from <notebook dir>/public for markdown images; the pod workdir must hold nothing secret there. Residual noted
classification_of_remaining_routes./api/kernel/ (run, execute, scratchpad/r: allow: core editing/run; execute and scratchpad run code but that is the same power as a cell
classification_of_remaining_routes./api/kernel/format: allow: formats cell text with the pod's formatter; no file or network side effects beyond running ruff/black on the given code
classification_of_remaining_routes./api/kernel/delete: allow: deletes a CELL from the in-memory document, not a file
classification_of_remaining_routes./api/kernel/save, /api/kernel/save_app_c: allow: needed; save accepts a filename confined to the workspace dir (files.py:152-180)
classification_of_remaining_routes./api/documentation/snippets: allow: static snippet text (raw call without Marimo-Session-Id returns 500 from marimo)
classification_of_remaining_routes./api/export/{html,ipynb,markdown,script,: allow: return the notebook in another format to the requester; no files written
classification_of_remaining_routes./api/sql/validate: allow: parses a SQL string with sqlglot; no connection made

dot_segment_bypass: see results/q6-bypass.json (before) and q6-bypass-fixed.json (after); proxy.py forwarded_path()
kernel_status_500: GET /e/api/kernel/status returned 500 in q6-terminal.json because the raw fetch had no Marimo-Session-Id header: marimo answers 500 {'detail':'Missing Marimo-Session-Id header'} (deps.py require_current_session_id); a bogus id also 500. It reached marimo; not a proxy fault. On /r it is 401 because the route requires edit scope. /api/documentation/snippets behaves the same.
